step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents MX Player's video ingestion, pre-transcoding, transcoding, and delivery pipeline. Ingest begins with the CMS pushing content to EC2 (Pre-Transcoding API). EC2 triggers Pre-Transcoding workers (Auto Scaling), writes to SQS, and writes task entries to ElastiCache. Pre-Transcoding workers process initial media metadata/audio, send messages to SQS, and trigger Transcoding workers (Auto Scaling). Transcoding workers poll jobs from SQS, read raw content from S3, write metadata/tasks to ElastiCache, and write processed video streams back to S3. For playback, end consumers request video through CloudFront, which fetches content directly from S3.
